errors.evidence: The description states the Y-axis range is from 17000 to 29000, but the axis labels clearly start at 15000.
The description states the Y-axis labels are spaced by 1000 leva, but the chart shows they are spaced by 2000 (e.g., 15000, 17000, 19000).

errors.text_span: На графиката е представена една линия в син цвят с кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The description states there is only one line, but the chart clearly displays two separate data series: one solid line and one dotted line with circular markers.

The description claims to describe the line with markers, but its stated starting value of ~18500 corresponds to the starting point of the solid line. The line with markers actually starts at a lower value, around 17500.
The description states the line ends at approximately 28000 in 2022. However, neither line reaches this value. The solid line ends around 27500, and the dotted line ends around 26500.

errors.text_span: Между 2020 и 2021 линията показва по-голям наклон
errors.evidence: The description attributes a steeper slope between 2020 and 2021 to the line with markers. In the chart, it is the solid line that shows a sharp increase in slope after 2020; the line with markers maintains a relatively steady rate of increase.
